scenes.title: 一城山水
lines: 这座城，把山水写进了自己的故事。
This city writes its story in hills and water.
一面是湖，一面是江。
A lake on one side. A river on the other.
杭州的年轮，就藏在它们之间。
Between them lie the rings of Hangzhou.

scenes.title: 杭州之名
lines: 公元五百八十九年，隋朝设置杭州。
In 589, the Sui established Hangzhou prefecture.
这个名字，沿着时光流传至今。
The name has travelled through the centuries.
城，依着西湖东岸展开。
The city took shape east of West Lake.

scenes.title: 运河通南北
lines: 运河把杭州，接入了南北水路。
The canal connected Hangzhou to north and south.
船载着粮食、丝绸，也载来远方。
Boats brought grain, silk, and distant worlds.
一座江南城市，从此有了更大的天地。
A city in Jiangnan found a wider horizon.

scenes.title: 吴越钱塘
lines: 五代，杭州成为吴越国的都城。
In the Five Dynasties, Hangzhou was Wuyue's capital.
城郭、海塘与寺塔，留下新的印记。
City walls, sea dikes and temples left their marks.

scenes.title: 一堤留千年
lines: 一千零九十年，苏轼主持疏浚西湖。
In 1090, Su Shi directed the dredging of West Lake.
挖出的湖泥，筑成一条贯湖南北的长堤。
Dredged mud became a causeway across the lake.
后来，人们叫它苏堤。
People would call it the Su Causeway.

scenes.title: 南宋临安
lines: 一千一百三十八年，南宋定都临安。
In 1138, Lin'an became the Southern Song capital.
皇城在南，街市向北。
The palace lay south; the markets stretched north.
湖山之间，铺开一幅繁华的城市长卷。
Between lake and hills, urban life unfolded.

scenes.title: 把西湖迎进城
scenes.en: THE CITY OPENS TO THE LAKE
lines: 一九一三年，拆城开路。
In 1913, walls came down and roads opened.
城墙退去，西湖与街巷重新相遇。
The lake and city streets met again.
城市的边界，开始向外舒展。
The city's boundaries began to open outward.

scenes.title: 向钱塘江生长
lines: 进入新世纪，杭州把目光投向钱塘江。
In the new century, Hangzhou looked to the Qiantang.
二零零一年，钱江新城开工建设。
Construction of Qianjiang New City began in 2001.
城市的重心，开始从湖畔走向江岸。
The city's focus moved from lakeside to riverbank.

scenes.title: 一江连接两岸
lines: 桥梁跨过江面，两岸彼此连接。
Bridges crossed the water, joining the two banks.
钱江新城、滨江、钱江世纪城，交相呼应。
Qianjiang New City, Binjiang and Century City grew together.
曾经的城市边缘，成为新的中心。
What was once an edge became a new centre.

scenes.title: 三处世界遗产
lines: 二零一一年，西湖文化景观列入世界遗产。
West Lake's cultural landscape was inscribed in 2011.
二零一四年，大运河。
The Grand Canal followed in 2014.
二零一九年，良渚古城遗址。
The Archaeological Ruins of Liangzhu City in 2019.
三个时间坐标，照见杭州的深度。
Three points in time reveal Hangzhou's depth.

scenes.title: 古今在此交汇
lines: 今天，新的楼宇沿江而立。
Today, new towers stand along the river.
新的想象，在这座城里生长。
New possibilities grow within the city.
但湖、河与江，仍是读懂杭州的线索。
Lake, canal and river still tell us who Hangzhou is.

scenes.title: 一城山水，千年生长
lines: 年轮向外，山水在心。
The rings grow outward. The landscape stays at heart.
这，就是杭州。
This is Hangzhou.
